title: 2-Digit Addition Worksheets Without Regrouping
intro: Use this worksheet to teach place value before introducing regrouping.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Build 23 and 14 with tens and ones. Place the matching units together, then connect the model to the columns in 23 + 14.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

23: 2 tens and 3 ones.

14: 1 ten and 4 ones.

20 + 10 = 30
3 + 4 = 7
30 + 7 = 37

Ask your student

What does the 2 in 23 stand for?

If your student needs help

If the columns are misaligned, have the student label the tens and ones before adding.
